tokens.name: charcoal-brown
tokens.usage: Palette. Ink in light, the raised surface in dark. Refer to it through `ink` / `surface-raised`, not directly.

tokens.name: olive-bark
tokens.usage: Palette. Secondary brand colour: 'played' and enjoyment. Use through `olive` and `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: golden-bronze
tokens.usage: Palette. Highlight: stars, 'both great', novelty. Use through `accent`. Fails 4.5:1 as text on light-yellow (3.0:1): never set text in it on the light surface.

tokens.name: light-yellow
tokens.usage: Palette. Paper surface in light, ink in dark. Use through `surface` / `ink`.

tokens.name: chocolate
tokens.usage: Palette. The brand colour: primary actions, the picked card, progress. Use through `brand`. White text on it is only 3.2:1, so text on it is `on-brand` (near-black).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. All body text colours are checked against it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, pick buttons, inputs, list containers. Sits on `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells: box-art letterboxing, segmented control track, empty progress pips.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunk` and every `*-soft` tint (≥ 9:1). Also the focus ring (3px) and the fill of selected chips.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: facts lines, hints, kicker labels. ≥ 4.8:1 on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunk`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: list dividers, card outlines, dock top border. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, chips, answer buttons, empty pips). ≥ 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, picked-card ring, filled progress pips, busy spinner. Text on it is `on-brand`. In dark it is also fine as large text (5.1:1 on `surface`).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `brand` fills (5.05:1).

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Brand-coloured text: links, rank numerals, text on `brand-soft`. ≥ 4.7:1 on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `brand-soft`.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tint for host badges, avatar hue 0, highlight wells. Text on it is `ink` or `brand-ink`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Stars, 'both great', novelty sparkle, checked-chip tick disc. Marks and fills only; text on it is `on-accent`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent` fills.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint for 'Unplayed pair' tags, info notices, avatar hue 2. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: olive
tokens.usage: 'Played' and enjoyment: reason icons, switch-on track, 'Played both' tag text. ≥ 4.5:1 on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `olive-soft`.

tokens.name: on-olive
tokens.usage: Knob and text on `olive` fills.

tokens.name: olive-soft
tokens.usage: Tint for 'Played both' tags, success notices, avatar hue 1.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and invalid-input borders; always with the alert icon and words. Intentional addition: the palette has no red, and chocolate must keep meaning 'go'.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error notice background. Text on it is `ink`; its icon is `danger`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 3px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element. Reads ≥ 9:1 on every surface.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: One per screen at most: payoff heading, invite title.

styles.name: game-name
styles.usage: Game names on cards and picks; clamp to 2–3 lines.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Nobody's played it and everyone's likely to enjoy it.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps, pip gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between chips; inner padding of picks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between the two picks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter, row padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between screen sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding; cover insets.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Top of hero screens (payoff, invite).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, keyboard hints.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, box-art frames, notices.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, picks, lists, empty states: the 'game box lid'.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, switches, avatars, progress pips.

shadow.note: Flat, hard 'cardboard edge' shadows: things sit on the table, they don't float.

tokens.name: shadow-edge
tokens.usage: Resting cards, picks, secondary buttons. Removed on :active (pressed flat).

tokens.name: shadow-brand-edge
tokens.usage: Primary button bottom edge.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Only the fanned box art on the invite page and OG image.
